items.markdown:
Microneedling is generally **not considered painful** , though most people feel mild discomfort or a strange sensation depending on the area treated and the depth of the needles.[[1]](https://www.harleystreetskinclinic.com/articles/does-microneedling-hurt-what-you-really-need-to-know/)[[2]](https://drsabaraja.co.uk/blog/microneedling-everything-you-need-to-know/)[[3]](https://havaaesthetics.com/blog/uncategorised/does-microneedling-hurt)[[4]](https://thewellnessclubtampa.com/does-microneedling-hurt/)[[5]](https://drbishop.com/does-microneedling-hurt/)[[6]](https://beautysculptingroom.co.uk/microneedling/is-microneedling-painful/)

### What It Feels Like

- **Sensation:** Most people describe the feeling as a light prickling, scratching, or a vibrating toothbrush gliding over the skin—similar to a mild sunburn.[[1]](https://www.hannahmccoyclinic.co.uk/blog/8163/aesthetics/does-microneeding-hurt)[[2]](https://www.hcmedspa.com/blog/does-microneedling-hurt)[[3]](https://drsabaraja.co.uk/blog/microneedling-everything-you-need-to-know/)
- **With Numbing Cream:** Practitioners usually apply a medical-grade topical anesthetic cream for 20 to 30 minutes before the session starts, which blocks local pain receptors and keeps the treatment very comfortable.[[1]](https://www.hcmedspa.com/blog/does-microneedling-hurt)[[2]](https://havaaesthetics.com/blog/uncategorised/does-microneedling-hurt)
- **Sensitive Areas:** Bony or thinner-skinned areas—such as the **forehead**, **jawline**, **nose** , and **upper lip** —tend to feel more sensitive or sharper than the cheeks.[[1]](https://beautysculptingroom.co.uk/microneedling/is-microneedling-painful/)[[2]](https://havaaesthetics.com/blog/uncategorised/does-microneedling-hurt)[[3]](https://herspacemedspa.com/does-microneedling-hurt/)
- **Needle Depth:** Shallower treatments for texture and glow cause very little sensation, while deeper treatments for severe scars or stretch marks can feel more intense.[[1]](https://thewellnessclubtampa.com/does-microneedling-hurt/)[[2]](https://beautysculptingroom.co.uk/microneedling/is-microneedling-painful/)

### How Practitioners Minimize Discomfort

- **Fast Oscillating Devices:** Modern automated pens (like the [Dermapen 4](https://www.dermapenworld.com/en-au/blog/microneedling-hurts-10-myths) ) move needles vertically and rapidly, which reduces tugging and stinging compared to manual derma-rollers.
- **Adjustable Depth:** Your provider can lower the needle depth on the fly if you hit a sensitive spot.[[1]](https://www.dermapenworld.com/en-au/blog/microneedling-hurts-10-myths)[[2]](https://www.hannahmccoyclinic.co.uk/blog/8163/aesthetics/does-microneeding-hurt)[[3]](https://beautysculptingroom.co.uk/microneedling/is-microneedling-painful/)[[4]](https://havaaesthetics.com/blog/uncategorised/does-microneedling-hurt)[[5]](https://drbishop.com/does-microneedling-hurt/)
